summary: Pin is steep bush above the gardens road; nowhere to stop.
reasons: Gardens road has no parking or verge

drivers.seclusion: Very secluded bush, with a quarry road above; no dwellings mapped or seen.
drivers.access_and_room: No track or clearing reaches the pin. The nearby sealed gardens road has yellow edge lines and no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Gardens road passes about 25 m east; quarry works lie beyond the cliff to the north-west.
drivers.convention: No sign of anyone staying here.

flags: Steep: 21% mean grade, 47% max at the pin
Quarry noise and workings to the north-west
sun_shade: Under dense tree canopy; open to the north-west over the quarry.
cannot_judge: Parking rules on the gardens road
